title: Alarm State Machine
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: State Machines
Alarm Clock
Snooze
Events
description: Interactive vis-network state diagram of an alarm clock. Event buttons move the highlight between IDLE, ARMED, RINGING and SNOOZED, while a clock model and the alarm_on, ringing and fired variables update; events with no arrow are shown as ignored.

learningObjectives: Apply a state diagram to predict the next state after a sequence of events
Explain why the fired flag stops the alarm from restarting during the same minute
Calculate the new ring time after one or more snoozes

keyQuestions: Which events can leave the RINGING state?
Why does pressing Time matches right after Stop not ring again?
What happens to the ring time after two snoozes?
commonMisconceptions: Every button does something in every state (events with no arrow are ignored)
Stop turns the alarm off (it returns to ARMED, so the alarm still rings tomorrow)
assessmentOpportunities: Trace a list of events to a final state
Explain the role of the fired flag

controls.label: Toggle alarm
controls.description: Turns the alarm on (IDLE to ARMED) or off (ARMED or SNOOZED to IDLE).

controls.label: Time matches
controls.description: Jumps the clock to the next ring time.

controls.label: Stop
controls.description: Stops a ringing alarm or cancels a snooze.

controls.label: Snooze
controls.description: Silences a ringing alarm for 9 minutes.

controls.label: 60 seconds pass
controls.description: Advances the clock one minute; a ringing alarm gives up.
